summary: Betty Jean Shefts worked in linguistics, Tibetology, and Indology. She studied under Franklin Edgerton (attested 1985) and Geshe Ngawang Nyima.
Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya is a scholar in Buddhist studies who taught Surendra Man Bajracharya. He has served as Dean at Lumbini Buddhist University and Chairman at the Lotus Research Centre.

Bhadriraju Krishnamurti was an Indologist and linguist who earned his A.M. and Ph.D. at the University of Pennsylvania (c. 1954–1957) studying under Murray Barnson Emeneau. He taught at Andhra, UC Berkeley, Osmania, and Hyderabad.

Bhagavan Das was an Indologist and philosopher who earned an M.A. from the University of Calcutta (c. 1886–1887). He founded Banaras Hindu University and Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith, where he served as headmaster (c. 1921–1926).
Bhagirath Prasad Tripathi is an Indologist and linguist. He held posts at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1976), where he was head of the Research Department (attested 1989).

Bhagwan Dash was an Indologist who studied at ITRA, Tribhuvan University, and the University of Delhi, earning an M.A. and Ph.D. He worked as a bibliographer and cataloguer at the Library of Congress.

Bhagwanlal Indraji was an archaeologist, historian, and Indologist who received an honorary doctorate from Leiden University (c. 1884). He held posts at the Royal Asiatic Society, Asiatic Society of Mumbai, and University of Mumbai.

Bhajagovinda Ghosh worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. In 1994, he was attested as an Editorial Board Member for the Bulletin of Tibetology and as Assistant Director of the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.

Bharat Bhushan Vidyalankar is a linguist and Indologist who studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University. He held positions at Kendriya Hindi Sansthan and Sandhaan (1991).

Bhau Daji was a scholar in Indology and history/archaeology. He studied at Elphinstone College (c. 1840–1845) and Grant Medical College and Sir Jamshedjee Jeejeebhoy Group of Hospitals (c. 1845–1850).
Bhesh Narayan Dahal works in Indology and history/archaeology. As of 2018, he held posts at the National Archives of Nepal and served as an editorial board member for Documenta Nepalica.

Bhikkhu Anālayo is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at Peradeniya and habilitated at Marburg. His academic posts include positions at Hamburg, Dharma Drum Institute, Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy, and Barre Center.

Bhikkhu Bodhi is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned his B.A. from Brooklyn College and Ph.D. from Claremont Graduate University. He served as Editor at the Buddhist Publication Society and President of the Buddhist Association of the United States.

Bhikkhu Pāsādika is an Indologist, Tibetologist, and Buddhist studies scholar who earned degrees from Magadh and Punjabi universities. He held posts at Punjabi University, Göttingen Academy, Marburg, Würzburg, Bochum, and Frankfurt Buddhist Academy.
Bhikkhu U Dhammissara is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a Master of Arts under Sanu Mahatthanadull at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University (attested 2017).

Bhikkhuni Dhammanandā is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed her Doctor of Philosophy at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies (attested 2007) under supervisors Tilak Kariyawasam and Daya Edirisinghe.

Bhogilal Sandesara was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Rasiklal Chhotalal Parikh. He headed the Gujarati Department at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and served as Director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara.
Bhuvan Chandel is an Indologist and philosopher. She served as a Professor at Panjab University (attested 2003) and was Director of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study from c. 2003 to 2006.

Bhuwan Lal Joshi was an Indologist who studied at Patna University. He held academic posts at the University of California, Berkeley (c. 1963–1967) and served as Professor at the University of California, Santa Cruz (c. 1967–1977).

Bidia Dandaron was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Saint Petersburg State University of Civil Aviation and the University of Saint Petersburg under Andrei Ivanovich Vostrikov. He later was a research fellow at IMBTS.
